name: Shirahime Juuya
source:
"Grand battle." "Sweeping scale." "The greatest staff."
"The most powerful" young girl...
Has no power. No magic. No specialties.
... What she's got is blind naivete.
Shirahime, the sword goddess...
... is here. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE147893.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“大战”。“横扫全场”。“最强队伍”。
“最强”少女……
没有力量，没有魔法，没有特长。
……她拥有的只有盲目天真。
白姬，剑之女神……
……登场。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE147893.html]DLsite English[/url]]
